C-REASON-CONSTANTS.Summary: Extract one module-local named constant for the unscoped-review not-run reason "no --change supplied", shared by the three !options.changeId arms in src/review/core.ts after C-AMENDMENT-COUNT lands. Cleanup, not a defect: the literals are consistent today. No new src/*.ts file, no export, no wording change.
C-REASON-CONSTANTS.Problem:
ngrace review reports a not-run audit with a free-text reason. The string "no --change supplied" is a literal at two production sites today, both in src/review/core.ts, both on !options.changeId:
src/review/core.ts:1543 attemptPairAudit (C-SUBSTANTIATION-HONESTY)
src/review/core.ts:1585 writeEvidenceScopeAudit (C-DECLARED-WRITES)
C-AMENDMENT-COUNT (approved spec, draft plan at this HEAD) adds a third for amendmentCountAudit, specified to reuse the same phrase (plan.xml:518 reuse `no --change supplied`). Extracting the constant before that bundle lands would mean adding a literal back immediately afterwards. This bundle is sequenced after C-AMENDMENT-COUNT is applied.
Three literals that must stay synonymous is how "not run: no --change supplied" and "skipped: --change was not provided" would coexist and mean the same thing. That has not happened. Measured 2026-09-02 at HEAD 0313873: the two sites are identical; grep of the second phrasing across the tree returns nothing. Live unscoped `bun run ngrace review --path .` (exit 0, read from the command, not through a pipe) prints:
WriteEvidence scope audit: not-run — no --change supplied Attempt-pair audit: not-run — no --change supplied
No Amendment count line yet; that line arrives with C-AMENDMENT-COUNT.
This is a cleanup, not a defect fix, and not debt. The literals agree today. The bundle exists so they cannot silently diverge.

Goals.Goal: One file-level unexported const NO_CHANGE_SUPPLIED_REASON in src/review/core.ts whose value is exactly the present phrase "no --change supplied". The three !options.changeId not-run arms (attemptPairAudit, writeEvidenceScopeAudit, amendmentCountAudit) assign reason from that const. The quoted literal appears once in the file, as the initializer.
Unscoped ngrace review keeps printing that same reason on every not-run audit that currently uses the literal. Wording does not change.

AcceptanceCriteria.AC-ONE-CONST: After the change, src/review/core.ts declares exactly one NO_CHANGE_SUPPLIED_REASON whose initializer is the quoted string "no --change supplied". That quoted string occurs once in the file. The const is not exported and is not a MODULE_MAP entry.

A fourth production assignment of that quoted string is a failure. HEAD before C-AMENDMENT-COUNT has two sites; this criterion is not satisfiable until that bundle is applied.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-WORDING-UNCHANGED: Unscoped `bun run ngrace review --path .` still prints `not-run — no --change supplied` on WriteEvidence scope audit, Attempt-pair audit, and Amendment count. The tests at src/review/core.test.ts:1817 and :2072 stay green without being rewritten to import the constant. Discrimination: changing the initializer so it no longer matches /no --change/ must fail those tests; keeping the value and switching the three arms to the const must not.
